ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, Jia is marked in China’s eastern coastal region; the legend corresponds different shadings to location index levels, among which the area where Jia is located corresponds to a high-value area with a location index greater than 40. Combined with the advantage items listed in the question stem, the developed eastern coastal area where Jia is located usually has convenient transportation, and at the same time has a developed economy and relatively strong scientific research, education, and technical strength; compared with “rich resources” or “a good foundation as an important old industrial base,” the other advantage of this region more fits a high level of science and technology. Therefore, the blank should be filled with “science and technology.”

raw_record.question_text: According to <image1>, region Jia has a location index greater than 40, and its other advantage is mainly reflected in a high level of ______.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中甲的位置和图例，确认甲属于区位指数大于40的东部沿海高值区。再读题干给出的优势项：交通便利、资源丰富、老工业基地基础好、科技水平高。根据东部沿海发达地区的典型区位优势，判断除交通便利外，另一优势是科技水平高，因此空格填“科技”。
